Scrum is a framework with defined roles and ceremonies that guide delivery by providing the general structure in which to operate. The flexible framework can be used to manage any type of project.

This method details the EY approach for employing Scrum based Agile practices. It does so by defining the activities, tasks and work products that enable the Scrum roles and ceremonies, covering the entire project lifecycle. The method provides supporting instructions from initial definition of a vision, that informs product backlog creation, through to sprint retrospectives and project closure.

Element.Name: define_product_vision_backlog
Element.attribute: Initiate the project by defining the scope, vision and initial backlog. Identify the necessary resources to support the work, acquire the team and conduct release planning.

Element.Name: doc_def_done_ready
Element.DisplayName: Document the definitions of done and ready

Element.Name: execute_sprints
Element.attribute: Initiate delivery via iterative sprints. The scope for each sprint will be individually assessed, evaluated, selected and executed. While the scope for each sprint will vary, the structure of the tasks will remain relatively constant starting with sprint planning through to the sprint retrospective.

Element.Name: close_project
Element.attribute: Formally, or informally depending on the nature of the engagement, close the project by confirming all objectives and agreements were satisfied.
